== Epic Otto's Irresistible Box ==

A jam-packed bundle that contains the following:
* 1 [[Stone of Experience|Stone of Epic Experience]] (2 million [[XP]])
* 5 {{item|Superior Experience Elixir}}s
* 5 {{item|Major Slayer Count Boost}}s
* 6 {{item|Greater Treasure Hunter's Elixir}}s
* 5 {{item|Siberys Spirit Cake}}s
* 3 {{item|Greater Siberys Spirit Cake}}s
* 1 {{item|Complete Reincarnation Timer Reset}}
* {{CoV|1300}}
* Your choice of either a [[Red Gelatinous Cube-let]] [[Creature Companion]] or 65 [[Astral Shard]]s.

Stone of Experience Information:
* Grants two million XP towards the user's epic level
* Can be used at any time during the epic level range (Level 20+).
* The XP grant can be increased by using Experience Elixirs or acquiring other XP-boosting effects before using the stone.

IMPORTANT:
* XP granted caps at epic level cap (Level 30)
* Minimum Level for Usage: 20
* Only one Stone of Epic XP can be used per life. (All types of reincarnation reset this except for Lesser Reincarnation.)

NOTE: Otto's box and the [[Stone of Experience|Stone of Epic Experience]] inside are tradable. The other items inside are not.
